facts.business: Axentra Corp Limited is an IT and software solutions company focused on Artificial Intelligence, software development, technology solutions, and digital services, having transitioned from real estate and housing development.
facts.related_party_note: During the year ended 31 March 2026, the Company recorded revenue of Rs. 657.75 lakhs from transactions with an entity classified as a related party due to common management and governance connections. Such revenue represented a significant portion of the Company's total revenue for the year.
